regeneration.method:
COSTFIX regeneration (PBS only). The sft_plan branch of j12_cost_axes.price_arm_episodes now prices the
replayed plan event instead of the source's last planner usage, so every report that prices an sft_plan arm
through it changes. This script:

  * compares each committed report as of git HEAD (pre/, `git show HEAD:<path>`) with the fixed-code default
    output (out2/def_*), and with a HEAD-code regeneration (out2/head_*) where one exists;
  * writes the regenerated report into campaign/results (the script's own output; j17 is spliced section by
    section only if a HEAD-code regeneration does not reproduce the committed file);
  * writes out2/changed_keys.json: per report, every key whose value changes (old -> new), keys added and
    removed (per-episode rows summarised), and Markdown line changes.
Reports that read no sft_plan arm through the branch (j16 F_f/F_g, b2) are checked and left untouched.
